scope: Independent DCE official-vs-RQ data review only

findings.title: Rows requiring quarantine before genuine-bar use
findings.required: Keep zero-volume rows out of genuine bars; quarantine incompatible OHLC and source conflicts with provenance. Do not expand high/low or forward-fill prices to fabricate valid bars.

findings.title: Volume and closing OI have a source/time unit seam
findings.evidence: Official/RQ yearly modal ratio is 1 through 2019 and 2 in 2020-2022, with explicit nonmodal rows.
findings.required: Declare source and period unit policy, preserve raw units, and quarantine nonmodal differences; never apply a single full-history divisor or mix closing OI with TQ opening OI.

findings.title: Monthly RQ bundle does not reach the requested 2026-10-16 cutoff
findings.required: Verify a separate actual latest-date source through 2026-10-16; metadata and raw row counts alone do not close this gap.

overfitting: No new fit or selection was performed; continue only data validation and declared source reconciliation.
